newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine central bank sets derivatives margins.
newsitem.headline: Argentine central bank sets derivatives margins.

text.p: Argentina's central bank said Tuesday it has adopted a resolution requiring financial institutions to adopt capital adequacy requirements similar to those of Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) countries when they invest in derivatives.
The central bank said financial institutions will have to make available the necessary "liquidity or stocks and bonds in guarantees to cover investments on futures, options and other derivatives."

The move is seen as a step in preparation for the anticipated introduction of a futures and options market on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange which has been talked about for months. Argentina already has an established commodities futures and options market.
